name: aadhaar-input
title: Aadhaar Input
description: Masks Aadhaar entry as XXXX XXXX 1234 (reveal on demand), checks the Verhoeff check digit and the no-0-or-1 first digit, recognises a VID, enrolment ID, masked copy, PAN or mobile pasted by mistake, strips photocopy separators and says how the number is stored.

meta.summary: An Aadhaar field that masks the number as it is typed and catches typos, pasted VIDs, PANs or mobile numbers before KYC rejects them.
meta.server: Verify the number through an authorised KYC/eKYC provider on the server, and avoid storing or logging full Aadhaar numbers unless you are permitted to.
catches: Typos and swapped neighbouring digits, via the Verhoeff check digit
A first digit of 0 or 1, which Aadhaar numbers never use
A 16-digit VID, 28-digit enrolment ID, masked copy, PAN or mobile number pasted by mistake
Spaces, dashes and dots from a photocopy or PDF, and Indian-script or full-width digits
Letters typed for look-alike digits (O, I, l, S)
limits: Format and checksum only: it does not confirm the number exists or belongs to this person
On a failed check digit it offers to reveal the number rather than guessing which digit is wrong
Masking is visual; your form still receives the full number unless you handle it otherwise
The storage note only describes what you pass in `storage`; it does not store or encrypt anything
a11y: Visible <label> tied to the input; aria-invalid and aria-describedby point at the error and storage note
Show/hide is a real button with aria-pressed and an aria-label, and returns focus to the field
Status changes are announced through a role="status" region
Icons are aria-hidden; errors carry text, not only colour

rules.note: Not verified on 2026-10-17: the UIDAI site did not respond. The no-0-or-1 first digit, Verhoeff check digit, 16-digit VID and masked-Aadhaar conventions are unchecked here.
